description: This PHP class defines a database migration script for version 5.5.0 of OrangeHRM, handling schema updates, internationalization, permissions, and workflow states related to the claim module.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for database schema and data updates for OrangeHRM version 5.5.0, including internationalization, permissions, and workflow states related to claims.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Main method executing the migration steps: schema updates, internationalization, permissions, menu setup, and workflow states.

methods.name: modifyClaimTables
methods.description: Adjusts schema of claim-related tables, converting character sets and updating columns to boolean types.

methods.name: modifyClaimRequestCurrencyToForeignKey
methods.description: Adds foreign key constraint to 'currency_id' in 'ohrm_claim_request' table.

methods.name: changeClaimExpenseTypeTableStatusToBoolean
methods.description: Converts 'status' field in 'ohrm_expense_type' to boolean type.

methods.name: changeClaimEventTableStatusToBoolean
methods.description: Converts 'status' field in 'ohrm_claim_event' to boolean type.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Inserts menu items into the system menu structure.

methods.name: getParentId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a menu item by title and parent ID.

methods.name: getScreenId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a screen by name.

methods.name: checkClaimExists
methods.description: Checks if the 'Claim' menu item exists.

methods.name: cleanClaimScreens
methods.description: Removes specific claim-related screens from the database.

methods.name: insertWorkflowState
methods.description: Inserts a workflow state for claim process.

methods.name: removeMarketplaceTables
methods.description: Drops marketplace-related tables if they exist.

methods.name: updateI18nGroups
methods.description: Updates language string groups for claim-related units.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes translation entries for a specific language string unit.
